plan.title: Docker Container — Dockerfile, supervisord, wait-for-pg, Health Endpoint

task.description:
Create server/Dockerfile based on pgvector/pgvector:pg16.
Multi-stage build: 1. Stage 1 (builder): python:3.12-slim, install Python deps from pyproject.toml. 2. Stage 2 (runtime): pgvector/pgvector:pg16, install Python 3.12, supervisord, copy built packages.
Key requirements: - Install supervisord via apt (supervisor package). - Copy server/ code into /app/. - Copy supervisord.conf to /etc/supervisord.conf. - Copy wait-for-pg.sh to /app/scripts/ and chmod +x. - EXPOSE 8000. - HEALTHCHECK: curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1 (interval=10s, timeout=5s, retries=3, start-period=30s). - CMD: ["supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"] - ENV: PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data, DATABASE_URL default for internal postgres. - Support EXTERNAL_DB=true: when set, supervisord config skips PostgreSQL program.
task.verification: `docker build -t smart-copilot-test ./server` succeeds. Dockerfile contains HEALTHCHECK directive. Dockerfile uses pgvector/pgvector:pg16 as base (runtime stage). EXPOSE 8000 is present.
task.done-condition: Docker image builds successfully. Dockerfile uses pgvector/pgvector:pg16 base, installs Python 3.12 + supervisord, includes HEALTHCHECK, exposes port 8000.

task.description:
Create server/supervisord.conf with nodaemon=true (required for Docker PID 1).
Programs: 1. [program:postgresql] — PostgreSQL managed via pg_ctlcluster or direct postmaster. autostart=true, autorestart=true, priority=10. Conditional: skip when EXTERNAL_DB=true (use environment-based conditional or separate config). 2. [program:fastapi] — Runs /app/scripts/wait-for-pg.sh which starts uvicorn after DB is ready. autostart=true, autorestart=true, priority=20 (starts after postgresql).
[supervisord] section: nodaemon=true, logfile=/var/log/supervisord.log.
CRITICAL: nodaemon=true must be set or container exits immediately.
task.verification: `grep "nodaemon=true" server/supervisord.conf` succeeds. Both postgresql and fastapi programs are defined. Priority ordering ensures postgresql starts before fastapi.
task.done-condition: supervisord.conf contains [supervisord] with nodaemon=true. Two programs defined: postgresql (priority=10) and fastapi (priority=20). PostgreSQL program can be skipped via EXTERNAL_DB.

dimension.name: risk
dimension.rationale: Bad config caught at container start

task.description:
Create server/scripts/wait-for-pg.sh — polls pg_isready, runs Alembic, starts uvicorn.
Script flow: 1. Wait for PostgreSQL: loop with pg_isready until success (max 60 retries, 1s apart). 2. Run alembic upgrade head (from /app/ directory, using sync DATABASE_URL). 3. Start uvicorn: `uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 1`.
When EXTERNAL_DB=true: skip pg_isready check (external DB assumed ready), still run alembic. Script must be executable (chmod +x in Dockerfile). Use #!/bin/bash shebang. Exit on any error (set -e).
task.verification: Script has #!/bin/bash shebang and set -e. Contains pg_isready polling loop. Runs `alembic upgrade head` before uvicorn. EXTERNAL_DB=true skips pg_isready.
task.done-condition: wait-for-pg.sh: polls pg_isready in a loop, runs alembic upgrade head, then starts uvicorn on 0.0.0.0:8000. EXTERNAL_DB=true skips the pg_isready check.

dimension.name: risk
dimension.rationale: Failure = container won't start, fast feedback

task.description:
Create server/app/main.py — FastAPI application with GET /health endpoint.
FastAPI app setup: - title="Smart Copilot", version="1.0.0" - CORS middleware with origins from settings.yaml server.cors_origins. - Include API routers (auth, admin, vault — added in later plans, import-guarded for now).
GET /health endpoint (in server/app/api/health.py): - Returns: { status: "ok", setup_required: bool, version: str, database: str, indexing: dict|null } - setup_required: true when users table has 0 rows. - database: "connected" or "error". - version: from config or system_config table. - indexing: null in Phase 1 (placeholder for Phase 2 progress). - This is the ONE route allowed to query DB directly (no service layer).
Startup event: - Load settings (fail fast if missing). - Create async engine and session factory. - Log "Smart Copilot backend started" at INFO.
task.verification: `python -c "from app.main import app; print(app.title)"` outputs "Smart Copilot". GET /health route is registered. Health endpoint returns setup_required field. CORS middleware is configured.
task.done-condition: FastAPI app starts with GET /health returning {status: "ok", setup_required: true, version: "1.0.0", database: "connected"|"error"} within 30 seconds of container start. CORS configured from settings.yaml.

task.description:
Create server/alembic.ini and server/alembic/env.py for migration infrastructure.
alembic.ini: - script_location = alembic - sqlalchemy.url placeholder (overridden by env.py).
alembic/env.py: - ONLY file that imports psycopg2 — add explicit comment: "psycopg2 only used here; app uses asyncpg." - get_url() converts DATABASE_URL from asyncpg to psycopg2 format. - target_metadata from app.models (Base.metadata). - run_migrations_offline() and run_migrations_online() standard functions. - Import all models so autogenerate detects them.
task.verification: `grep "psycopg2" server/alembic/env.py` returns a match. `grep "psycopg2" server/app/` returns no matches (enforcement rule). alembic.ini points to alembic/ script location. env.py imports target_metadata from app models.
task.done-condition: alembic/env.py is the only file importing psycopg2 (with explicit comment). Converts asyncpg URL to psycopg2 format. alembic.ini configured. script.py.mako template present.

plan.dependencies: PLAN-1-2 depends on PLAN-1-1 (needs pyproject.toml, config.py, directory structure)

decision.choice: Added entrypoint.sh to strip the postgresql program block when EXTERNAL_DB=true, rather than using supervisord include directives or a second static conf file.
decision.rationale: Supervisord has no native environment-conditional program loading. Using an entrypoint script that generates a filtered supervisord config at container start is the cleanest runtime approach without requiring two static conf files to be maintained in sync.
decision.alternatives-considered: Two static supervisord conf files (rejected: duplication); supervisord [include] with conditional path (rejected: still requires the file to exist at a fixed path); environment variable expansion in command= (rejected: supervisord does not skip a program if its command is empty).

decision.choice: Used try/except ImportError guards around auth/admin/vault router imports in main.py rather than conditional imports via importlib.
decision.rationale: Those modules are stub __init__.py files in Phase 1 without a router attribute. The try/except approach is idiomatic FastAPI for optional routers and avoids AttributeError as well as ImportError when the submodule exists but lacks the router symbol.
decision.alternatives-considered: importlib.util.find_spec (rejected: does not guard AttributeError on existing stubs); separate router registration module (rejected: over-engineering for Phase 1 stubs).

decision.choice: Imported Base from app.models.base (not re-exported via app.models.__init__) in alembic/env.py.
decision.rationale: app.models.__init__ imports all model classes for side effects (registering them against Base.metadata) but does not re-export Base itself. Importing directly from app.models.base is explicit and avoids relying on an undeclared __init__ export.
decision.alternatives-considered: Importing Base from app.models (rejected: Base is not exported from __init__); adding Base to __init__.__all__ (rejected: that would be a PLAN-1-1 concern, not appropriate to change here).
